lines.en: I trot along behind the Shell Beast.

lines.zh: 我爪子敲在石头上嗒嗒响。
lines.en: My claws tap a rhythm on the stone.
I make half a circle around my master.
My beak jabs forward with each step.
I splash through a puddle up to my knees.
I run faster than I look.
I stay behind it, never falling back.
My little claws grip well.
I hurry along the foot of the wall.
I step, pause, and listen.
I twist through the narrow gap.

lines.zh: 主人的影子就是我的路。
lines.en: My master's shadow is my road.
When I run, my beak arrives first.
I glance back to be sure it follows.
I stand still, my beak opening and closing.
I shake my wings and do not fly.
I wait for my master's order.

lines.zh: 我歪头，用喙敲了敲甲壳。
lines.en: I tilt my head and tap my shell with my beak.
A bug on the ground; I stare at it.
I tilt my head toward a distant sound.

lines.zh: 甲壳里传出低低的摩擦声。
lines.en: A low scraping comes from inside my shell.
I move only when the Shell Beast signals.
I give a short, sharp snort.
I stand close against my master's leg.
There is a hint of rust on my beak.
I blink, slowly, once.

lines.zh: 甲壳兽叫我，我就在这儿。
lines.en: The Shell Beast calls, and I am here.
I stretch my neck to look around.
I lift my head to my master's profile.

lines.zh: 我把爪子换了个地方踩。
lines.en: I shift my claws to a new spot.
You stand too close to my master.
I look up with my beak aimed at you.
Is there something in your hand?

lines.zh: 我侧着身，用一只眼看你。
lines.en: I turn sideways and watch you with one eye.
You are not my master; I know it.
Your shadow is shorter than my master's.
I stare at your knees.
When your hand moves, I tense up.
I tilt my head to see you better.
Would you harm my master?
A low sound rolls in my throat.
Step back, and I loosen up.
Your scent still clings to my beak.
My master stays still, so I do too.
Only six hearts; stop hitting me.
The blow sent me head over heels.
My wing is bent, but I can still run.
That one really hurt.
I retreat behind my master.
My claws tremble; I cannot stand firm.
A cry squeezes out of my throat.

lines.zh: 我没有掉落，杀了也白杀。
lines.en: I drop nothing; killing me gains you nothing.
I cannot fall; my master needs me.
I pant, but I want another go.
That food goes to my master first.
I smell it, but I will not snatch.
You bend down; I step back half a pace.
My beak is small; I cannot take big bites.
Only when my master nods do I eat.
That smell makes me swallow hard.
I keep my eyes on your palm.
Toss it over; do not hand it to me.
One bite, then back to my post.
Do not try to pet me while I eat.

lines.zh: 我只有六点血，这壳会护住我。
lines.en: Six health points only; this shell guards me.

lines.zh: 我撞回去，个子小也不怕。
lines.en: I shove back; small does not mean scared.
Your nudge knocked me off balance.
My claws dig in and I hold.
Do not crowd my master's side.
A warning rattles in my throat.
Bump me and I call my master.
I am this light, and you still hit me?
I step back and circle behind you.
After the bump I press close again.
I was summoned; I have no mate.

lines.zh: 主人的命令比这事重要。
lines.en: My master's orders matter more.
I know only one master.
Do not bring that up in front of me.
I flap my wings and walk away.

lines.zh: 这具身子不是为这个造的。
lines.en: This body was not made for that.
Guarding my master is enough for me.
The Shell Beast never told me to do this.
Summoned things do not speak of it.
I turn back to my master's feet.
My claws cannot grip anything.
I pick up a pebble with my beak.
I only fetch what my master wants.
I cannot drag this bone.
I carry it two steps and drop it.
I kick it over to my master's feet.
My beak is too curved to hold tight.
Fetching is not my task.
I try to lift it and fail.
I drop it and go back to watching.
My master turns, and so do I.

lines.zh: 沙里一响，我的爪子就紧了。
lines.en: A rustle in the sand tightens my claws.
My master growls; my feathers rise.

lines.zh: 我盯住那个会动的影子。
lines.en: I lock onto that moving shadow.
My master moves first; I follow.
Strange footsteps are coming near.
My beak opens on its own.
That thing is coming for my master.
A growl starts in my throat.
I measure how far off it is.
My master halts; I halt too.
I step aside to give my master the lead.
I close in from the left.
My master blocks the front; I take the back.
I crouch low and creep forward.
It does not see me down this low.

lines.zh: 我离它的脚踝只有一步。
lines.en: I am one step from its ankle.
When my master roars, I pounce.
I aim for the tendon of its hind leg.
It turns; I shift with it.
I hug the ground without a sound.

lines.zh: 我们两个把它夹在中间。
lines.en: Between us, we have it boxed in.
It has backed against the wall.
I wait for my master to bite first.
My beak is already lined up.
I peck it hard on the calf.
Four points of damage is not much.
I clamp onto its heel and hold.
My master bites high; I bite low.
I leap, beak first.
One kick sends me sprawling.
I scramble up and charge again.
I stab at its fingers.
That one I took for my master.
I bite, then slip to the side.

lines.zh: 甲壳兽一挥手，我就来了。
lines.en: The Shell Beast gestures, and I arrive.

lines.zh: 我从召唤的裂缝里钻出。
lines.en: I crawl out of the summoning seam.
My master called; I could not refuse.
I open my eyes and look for my master.

lines.zh: 我的喙先出来，身子在后。
lines.en: My beak comes first, the rest after.

lines.zh: 甲壳兽一叫，我就从沙里钻出。
lines.en: When the Shell Beast calls, I rise from the sand.

lines.zh: 我抖掉身上的召唤残光。
lines.en: I shake off the summoning glow.

lines.zh: 这里没有我的巢，只有主人。
lines.en: I have no nest here, only a master.
I take my place at my master's left.
I count the faces around us.
I was not born naturally.
Where my master points, I go.

lines.zh: 我嗓子里第一声是应答。
lines.en: My first sound is an answer.

lines.zh: 我抬起喙，等下一个命令。
lines.en: I raise my beak for the next order.
A patch of my feathers is scorched.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下来，爪子疼。
lines.en: I fell from a height; my claws ache.
I cannot swim; pull me out.
The blast left only ringing in my ears.
An arrow sticks in my wing.
Cold light coils around my legs.
I am so hungry my beak feels soft.
Lightning struck; all my feathers stand.

lines.zh: 壳兽不在，这虚空我没法抓。
lines.en: My shell beast is gone, I cannot grip the void.
